title: Let service make your life weighty
summary: Service becomes fruitful when the whole life is offered through it. Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes fruitful when the whole life is offered through it.
source.lifeApplication: When the day feels thin, do the next task as service.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes fruitful when the whole life is offered through it.
evidence.turn: Remember this: the path becomes visible when service turns fruitful.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
